lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has fashioned His perfect fashion.
O Nanak, the Lord's devotees are blessed with glorious greatness. ||4||24||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad banaavahu ihu man ||
lines.translation: I have shaped this mind in the mold of the Guru's Word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa darasan sa(n)chahu har dhan ||1||
lines.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I have gathered the wealth of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ootam mat merai ridai too(n) aau ||
lines.translation: O sublime understanding, come, enter into my mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhiaavau gaavau gun govi(n)daa at preetam mohi laagai naau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: that I may meditate and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and love so dearly the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
I am satisfied and satiated by the True Name.
My cleansing bath at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage is the dust of the Saints. ||2||
I recognize that the One Creator is contained in all.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my understanding is refined. ||3||
I have become the servant of all; I have renounced my ego and pride.
The Guru has given this gift to Nanak. ||4||25||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
My intellect has been enlightened, and my understanding is perfect.
Thus my evil-mindedness, which kept me far from Him, has been removed. ||1||
Such are the Teachings which I have received from the Guru;

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: boodat ghor a(n)dh koop mahi nikasio mere bhaaee re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: while I was drowning in the pitch black well, I was saved, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
The Guru is the boat to cross over the totally unfathomable ocean of fire;
He is treasure of jewels. ||2||
This ocean of Maya is dark and treacherous.
The Perfect Guru has revealed the way to cross over it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਕਛੁ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaap taap kachh ukat na moree ||
lines.translation: I do not have the ability to chant or practice intense meditation.
Guru Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||4||26||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Thi-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras peevat sad hee raataa ||
lines.translation: One who drinks in the Lord's sublime essence is forever imbued with it,

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan rasaa khin mahi lahi jaataa ||
lines.translation: while other essences wear off in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras ke maate man sadaa ana(n)d ||
lines.translation: Intoxicated with the Lord's sublime essence, the mind is forever in ecstasy.
Other essences bring only anxiety. ||1||
One who drinks in the Lord's sublime essence, is intoxicated and enraptured;

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਛੇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan rasaa sabh hochhe re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: all other essences have no effect. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras kee keemat kahee na jaai ||
lines.translation: The value of the Lord's sublime essence cannot be described.
The Lord's sublime essence permeates the homes of the Holy.
One may spend thousands and millions, but it cannot be purchased.
He alone obtains it, who is so pre-ordained. ||2||
Tasting it, Nanak is wonder-struck.
Through the Guru, Nanak has obtained this taste.

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: eet oot kat chhod na jaai ||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, it does not leave him.
Nanak is imbued and enraptured with the Lord's subtle essence. ||3||27||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu mitaavai chhutakai duramat apunee dhaaree ||
lines.translation: If she renounces and eliminates her sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, and her evil-mindedness and self-conceit as well;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hoi nimaanee sev kamaavahi taa preetam hovahi man piaaree ||1||
lines.translation: and if, becoming humble, she serves Him, then she becomes dear to her Beloved's Heart. ||1||
Listen, O beautiful soul-bride: By the Word of the Holy Saint, you shall be saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਮਿਟੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖਮਨਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh bhookh mitai tero sahasaa sukh paavahi too(n) sukhaman naaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your pain, hunger and doubt shall vanish, and you shall obtain peace, O happy soul-bride. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਸ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan pakhaar karau gur sevaa aatam sudh bikh tiaas nivaaree ||
lines.translation: Washing the Guru's feet, and serving Him, the soul is sanctified, and the thirst for sin is quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਿ ਦਾਸਰੀ ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: daasan kee hoi daas daasaree taa paavahi sobhaa har duaaree ||2||
lines.translation: If you become the slave of the slave of the Lord's slaves, then you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੀ ਅਚਾਰ ਇਹੀ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihee achaar ihee biuhaaraa aagiaa maan bhagat hoi tumhaaree ||
lines.translation: This is right conduct, and this is the correct lifestyle, to obey the Command of the Lord's Will; this is your devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: jo ihu ma(n)tr kamaavai naanak so bhaujal paar utaaree ||3||28||
lines.translation: One who practices this Mantra, O Nanak, swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||28||
